settings.heading: More than 100,000 patients trust our treatment plans

settings.title: Potency tested
settings.text: A test to check the medication contains the correct concentration of active ingredient.

settings.title: Sterility Tested
settings.text: A test to check the medication is free of foreign organisms and pathogens.

settings.title: pH Level Tested
settings.text: A test to check for the ideal 'acid to base' ratio to minimize irritation caused by the injection itself.

settings.title: Endotoxicity Tested
settings.text: A test to check the medication adheres to endotoxin safety recommendations.

settings.question: How does ChopinRX work?
settings.answer: You pick a program or a single treatment, complete the intake in about ten minutes, and an independent licensed provider reviews it and prescribes if appropriate. A licensed U.S. compounding pharmacy ships to your door.

settings.question: Who decides what I am prescribed?
settings.answer: An independent licensed provider reviews your intake and medical history and makes the prescribing decision.

settings.question: What is the difference between a program and a treatment?
settings.answer: A program is a packaged combination reviewed as one plan. A treatment is a single item from the full menu.

settings.question: Is ChopinRX available in my state?
settings.answer: Availability depends on provider licensing in your state. You will see this during intake before anything is prescribed.

settings.question: Are these medications FDA approved?
settings.answer: Compounded medications are not FDA approved. They are prepared by licensed U.S. compounding pharmacies for an individual prescription.
